intent.proves: The share of category fields stored as a text type (field types 1, 10, 11, 12 and 13) stays at or under the limit, in percent.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Live parity review found category-field projection differs from complete stored-field scope or omits presentation. Do not claim equivalence.

bindings.query: SELECT ISNULL(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN FieldType IN (1, 10, 11, 12, 13) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 100) FROM EcomProductCategoryField WHERE FieldCategoryId <> N'reference_category'
